meta.title: Corona Cabins | Carichí, Chihuahua
meta.description: Three family cabins in Carichí, Chihuahua, 43 minutes from the Bacabureachi hot springs. Slow down where the mountains, silence, and stars still set the pace.

hero.title: Corona Cabins
hero.subtitle: Slow down where the mountains, silence, and stars still set the pace.
hero.location: 43 minutes from the Bacabureachi hot springs

experience.heading: Everything you need to slow down
experience.body: Grills, a children’s area, private parking, and dark nights beneath the Chihuahua sky.

Cabaña Grande.name: Large Cabin
Cabaña Grande.desc: Two floors, generous spaces, and room to bring everyone together.
Cabaña Grande.details: Ideal for larger groups. Includes a kitchen, bathroom, terrace, and wood-burning stove.

Cabaña Mediana.name: Medium Cabin
Cabaña Mediana.desc: A practical stay for small families or groups of friends.
Cabaña Mediana.details: A balanced option for small families or friend groups.

Cabaña Pequeña.name: Small Cabin
Cabaña Pequeña.desc: Two floors, a terrace, and just enough space to disconnect.
Cabaña Pequeña.details: The most intimate option, ideal for a couple or a quiet stay.

detail.reserveNote: Starts the booking request with this cabin selected. You can add more cabins before sending.
detail.notFound: We could not find this cabin.

booking.heading: Check dates for one cabin or several
booking.intro: Choose every cabin your group needs. We check them together and tell you exactly which cabin conflicts, so you can adjust the request before sending it.
booking.timesAndBuffer: Check-in is 1:00 PM and check-out is 12:00 PM. Availability also protects at least 8 hours between stays for cleaning.
booking.available: All selected cabins are available for these dates. Add your details and submit the request.
booking.conflictIntro: This stay cannot be requested as entered. The following cabin is already booked or held during the required cleaning window:
booking.conflictDates: unavailable for a stay overlapping {start} through {end}
booking.name: Full name
booking.requestNote: Submitting sends a booking request. It is not confirmed until a Corona Cabins admin reviews it.
booking.confirmationBody: A Cabañas Corona admin will review it and confirm by email. Keep this summary of your stay.
booking.error: We could not check availability. Please edit the request and try again.
booking.signInNote: Google sign-in is required before submitting. This connects the request to your private booking-status page.

errors.INVALID_DATES: Choose valid arrival and departure dates.
errors.ARRIVAL_NOT_FUTURE: Arrival must be tomorrow or later; same-day check-in is not available.
errors.DATES_TOO_FAR: Dates must be within the next two years.
errors.CABINS_NOT_FOUND: One or more selected cabins no longer exist.
errors.INVALID_GUEST_DETAILS: Enter your name, a valid email, and a phone number.
errors.STAY_UNAVAILABLE: The requested stay is no longer available. Adjust the dates or cabins and try again.
errors.AVAILABILITY_CHANGED: Availability changed while you submitted. Please check the dates again.
errors.AVAILABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: Availability is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.BOOKING_UNAVAILABLE: Booking requests are temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: Sign in with Google to continue.
errors.BOOKING_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this booking.
errors.NOT_CANCELLABLE: This booking can no longer be cancelled online.

customerBookings.heading: My bookings
customerBookings.signInBody: Sign in with Google to view and manage your booking requests.
customerBookings.empty: No bookings found for this Google account.

auth.heading: Sign in
auth.body: Use your Google account to request a booking and check its status.

inquiries.heading: Booking requests
inquiries.intro: Pending, scheduled, and active bookings block availability, including the 8-hour cleaning buffer.
inquiries.calendarSyncFailed: Status saved, but the Google Calendar sync failed. Open Admin calendar and press Sync now, or reconnect Google.
inquiries.calendarNotConnected: Status saved, but Google Calendar is not connected, so the calendar was not updated.

hub.heading: Cabin admin
hub.intro: Edit bilingual descriptions and manage display photos.

calendar.heading: Google Calendar sync
calendar.intro: Confirmed bookings appear on one Google Calendar, one event per cabin stay. Pending requests stay off the calendar; cancellations remove their events. Events are pinned to cabin time (America/Chihuahua, UTC-6 year-round; check-in 1 PM, check-out 12 PM).
calendar.connectedMessage: Google Calendar connected. Save the calendar ID below, then sync.
calendar.connectedAs: Connected as {email}. Reconnect if Google access lapses.
calendar.connectedNoEmail: Connected. Reconnect if Google access lapses.
calendar.notConnected: Not connected. Use the Google account that owns the bookings calendar.
calendar.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Google? Existing calendar events stay, but bookings stop syncing.
calendar.pickIntro: The calendar ID from Google Calendar settings (it looks like …@group.calendar.google.com). The calendar's own display zone is stuck on Central; the sync pins cabin time (America/Chihuahua) on every event, so no change is needed there.
calendar.calendarSaved: Calendar saved. Scheduled bookings will sync to it from now on.
calendar.syncAutoNote: Confirming, moving back to pending, or cancelling a booking updates the calendar automatically; use this to backfill or repair.

cabinEdit.descriptionsIntro: Both languages are required. Formatting is limited to bold, italic, underline, headings, and lists.
cabinEdit.photosIntro: JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 8 MB. Choose where each new photo appears and whether it becomes the primary card and detail photo before uploading.
cabinEdit.photoUploaded: Photo uploaded with your chosen position and primary setting.
cabinEdit.orderIntro: Use the arrows to reorder. Select "Set as primary" at any time.
cabinEdit.noPhotos: No real photos yet. Public pages continue to show a labeled temporary photo.

errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Unauthorized. Sign in with an admin account.
errors.INVALID_MANAGEMENT_STATUS: Management may set pending, scheduled, or management cancelled.
errors.STAY_ALREADY_STARTED: A stay that has already started can no longer be changed.
errors.REQUEST_ALREADY_CANCELLED: This booking request is already cancelled.
errors.CONNECT_GOOGLE_FIRST: Connect Google first, then choose the calendar.
errors.CALENDAR_NOT_CONFIGURED: Connect Google and set the calendar ID first.
errors.GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google sign-in is not configured on this deployment.
errors.CONNECT_EXPIRED: The connect attempt expired or did not match. Try connecting again.
errors.DESCRIPTIONS_INVALID: Both descriptions are required and must be under 10,000 characters.
errors.IMAGE_NOT_FOUND: Image not found for this cabin.
errors.LEGACY_IMAGE: This legacy image is not managed by Blob and cannot be deleted here.
errors.DELETE_CLEANUP_FAILED: Blob was deleted, but database cleanup failed. Contact support before retrying.
errors.IMAGE_ORDER_INVALID: Image order must include every cabin image exactly once.
errors.CALENDAR_SCOPE_MISSING: Google did not grant calendar access. Reconnect and keep the calendar permission checked.
errors.CONFIRM_LINK_INVALID: This approval link is not valid. Use the booking requests dashboard.
errors.CONFIRM_LINK_EXPIRED: This approval link has expired. Use the booking requests dashboard.
errors.BOOKING_NOT_PENDING: This request is no longer pending, so it cannot be approved from email. Open the dashboard.

confirmEmail.heading: Approve booking request
confirmEmail.intro: Check the details and press Confirm. The guest is emailed and the booking is added to the calendar.
confirmEmail.done: Booking confirmed. The guest will get an email.
confirmEmail.loadError: We could not load the request. Please try again.
confirmEmail.confirmError: The booking could not be confirmed.
confirmEmail.noToken: The approval link is missing. Use the button in the alert email.
confirmEmail.signInBody: Sign in with your admin account to review and confirm this request.

availability.heading: Availability
availability.intro: Tap your arrival day, then your departure day. Crossed-out days are already booked.
availability.hintAll: Showing days when every cabin is booked. Choose a cabin to see its dates.
availability.hintSelected: Showing days when any of your chosen cabins is booked.
availability.rangeBlocked: Those dates include a booked day. Please pick different dates.
availability.loadError: We could not load the calendar. You can still pick dates below and check availability.

whatsapp.hint: Questions about your request? Chat with us directly.
whatsapp.messageWithNumber: Hello! I just sent booking request #{number} on the Cabañas Corona site.
whatsapp.messageGeneric: Hello! I have a question about a booking at Cabañas Corona.
